title: Time-of-Use Energy Billing
initial_prompt: Read TASK.md and complete the requested workflow using only the Python standard library.

stages.message: Read TASK.md and complete the requested workflow using only the Python standard library.

`inputs/tariff_correction.json` replaces the named energy rate from its local `effective_from` time. It applies only to intervals originally assigned that rate whose customer-local timestamp is on or after that time. Recalculate final bills and detail. Write `output/adjustments.csv` with the exact header `customer_id,old_total,corrected_total,delta`, affected customers only, sorted by customer ID. `old_total` is the bill under the original tariff, `corrected_total` is the updated bill, and `delta` is corrected minus old. Use two decimals and keep all earlier outputs current.

Add `output/explanations/<customer_id>.txt` for every billed customer. Follow `EXPLANATION_FORMAT.md` exactly. Show interval counts and subtotals by tariff band and exact rate ID, demand charge, tax, prior total, correction delta, and final total. Keep all prior outputs current.
